activity_summary: Upstairs, you tried to recover the sermon and could not. One shard stayed: goods not yet in his hand. You ended by ordering yourself to attend properly next Sunday.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the memo and stopped on the order.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Named in the attempt. Not in the room.

facets.activity: Tried the sermon back and kept one shard

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Goods not yet in his hand. That is the shard.
